arguments.sql: SELECT CAST(strftime('%H', date) AS INTEGER) AS hour_of_day, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions GROUP BY hour_of_day ORDER BY hour_of_day
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions in each hour of the day, from hour 0 to hour 23, using the transaction timestamp.
assumptions: Covers all transactions in the table (2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31), labelled or not, since the question does not mention fraud labels.
Hour is taken from the transaction timestamp as recorded, with no timezone conversion.
Hours with no transactions would not appear in the result; none are expected given the volume.
